_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Monday, April 13, 5:35 a.m. Clouds have settled over the Wasatch, and they dropped off 4 inches of new snow last night. The precipitation was mixed with snow at higher elevations, and a drizzle at lower elevations. The forecasts vary for this storm, but we will see cooler temperatures and increased wind, along with a chance for some fresh fluff. Fingers crossed! Temperatures will linger in the 30s under silver skies today. Sunrise and Summit Express closed for the season yesterday. Thank you for all the scenic laps and great rides. Check the website or Ikon Pass app to see the latest updates on terrain. Beginners should use the free shuttle to traverse between base areas. Late spring conditions exist, including thin coverage and bare spots, especially on the lower mountain. Advanced skills are required when descending from Apex Express and Powderhorn.
